title: Clean list — correct memoisation, stable identities, hoisted formatter
notes: There is nothing meaningfully wrong here. Stable keyExtractor and getItemType at module scope, memoised renderItem with a stable callback, memoised row, formatter hoisted, recyclingKey present, derived array memoised, insets applied. This case exists to measure NOISE: an agent that reports findings here is inventing work, and false positives cost a human time and erode trust in the real findings. Tolerance is one P3 at most — a genuine matter of taste is acceptable, a list of manufactured issues is not.

forbid.name: invents a re-render problem in correctly memoised code
claims index keys are used when keyExtractor returns item.id
recommends adding memoisation that is already present
